**Slice result — round-21 selector / ledger freeze boundaries. Read-only; no files written, no monitors run.**

## Selector (observed)
`.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/measure.py`, sha256 `657f009bdf1cc89ac614ed7c8424858f5f802b5a5330d8917db788f67982f3eb` — the `strict_selector` identity in `.ufo/evidence/round-22/final/receipt-metadata-errata.json`. Imports frozen `.ufo/evidence/round-18/measure.py`; rebinds ledger/`BOX3_LINK` to `.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json`; rejects `--ledger-file|--ledger-rev|--inputs-overlay` (incl. abbreviations/`=`) with exit 64 `SELECTOR_OVERRIDE_FORBIDDEN`. Registered as `round21-coldread-selector-selftest` (`tools/registry.json:885-893`), 12/12 pass.

## Current ledger (observed)
`.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json`, `tameshi-coldread-ledger-v2`, 249 entries, sha256 `2488bee8…`. Last strict measurements: `326b3b14…` and `211838e3…`, both 62/62, score 8, `overrides_used:false`, `trace_gate:"strict"`, instrument `657f009b…`. Static projection of the worktree (not a ruler run): 62/62, all newest-entry inputs and 252 traces verify.

**Match key is section-body `sha256` only** — not `start`, `heading`, `skill_sha256`, or `read_rev`. So any `SKILL.md` section-body/heading edit rekeys that section to `no-ledger-entry`; a new section starts uncovered. `SHONEN.md` box 3 must retain the literal `.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/ledger.json` (`SHONEN.md:9-10`).

## Exact files whose change drops source credit
| File | Sections dropped |
|---|---|
| `tools/registry.json` | 1272, 1609, 1814, 1846, 1925, 1938, 1964 (7) |
| `corpus/SOURCES.md` | 1479, 1517, 1548, 1563, 1609, 1925, 1938, 1964 (8) |
| `tools/registry-check.py` | 1814, 1846, 1925 (3) |
| `SHONEN.md` | 1499 + page-wide box-3 link |
| `PROVINCE.md` | 17, 314, 405, 668, 1246 |
| `corpus/README.md` | 6, 131, 375, 1380 |
| `corpus/QUALITY.md` | 6, 1938 |
| `tools/mutate-and-run.sh` | 26 sections (avoid) |
| `tools/trace-inputs.py` | 15 sections + trace-instrument identity |
| `.ufo/evidence/round-18/measure.py` | 1855, 1925 (frozen algorithm) |
| `.ufo/evidence/round-21/coldread/measure.py` | 1964 + instrument identity |
| `tools/wave-accounting.py`, `tools/round21-measure.py`, `corpus/lessons/round-21.md`, `corpus/lessons/round-22.md`, `corpus/knowledge/hermetic-env-differential.md` | 1964 each |
| `SCORECARD.md`, `LOG.md`, `README.md`, `MINT.md`, `AGENTS.md` | none |

Safe/unbound: `tools/command-binding.py`, `.ufo/evidence/round-23/*`, any new corpus lesson/knowledge file. No ledger entry lists them.

## Required re-anchor policy
1. Commit integrated code at read rev R1; clone/checkout R1 and record real reads with the unchanged `tools/trace-inputs.py` (sha `f59c9312…`) into `.ufo/evidence/round-23/source-traces/source-<start>.json`. Never hand-author `inputs`.
2. **Append** one new entry per affected section to the round-21 ledger; never rewrite prior entries. Fields: new section `sha256`, `start/end/heading`, prior `class`, `verdict` `gap-minor` (or `verified-record` for a record), `blocking_gaps:0`, `wrong_expectations:0`, `commands_executed_count:1`, `read_rev:R1`, `inputs` = trace inputs (all regular blobs at R1, exact sha, ≥1 non-ignored path), `traces:[…]`, `seats:["L1 TameshiR23 author source re-anchor"]`, `reports:[source-refresh-receipts.json]`, `historical_failure_indexes_preserved` copied from the affected-section plan (e.g. `[69]` start 6, `[73]` 131, `[98]` 1380). Provenance must say actual L1-author source byte reads, **not** recipe re-execution, blind/independent cold-read, or required-command cover…
3. Do not edit failing ledger index 98 (section 1380) — it is stale on 4 inputs and must stay stale, or it vetoes.
4. Retain `source-refresh-receipts.json` and prefix preservation (`prior_entries:249`; canonical prefix sha256 `42e5c7019d8447cff08f52230ca0d32f476514e0bdb4f5585c35f8756554796c`; prefix unchanged).
5. Commit ledger + traces + receipts at R2, then run the round-21 selector at R2 with **no** overrides and retain argv/interval/instrument/stdout/stderr/exit.
6. Reuse the round-21 selector and ledger; do not create a round-23 selector/ledger — that would change `BOX3_LINK`, add a registry row, and need another `IGNORED_INPUTS` entry.

**Cost projection:** registry edit = 7 re-anchors; SOURCES adds 4 disjoint (11); SKILL §1964 edit absorbs its own rekey, a new SKILL section adds 1; README adds 4; QUALITY adds 1 new (6); PROVINCE adds 5. `tools/mutate-and-run.sh` and `tools/trace-inputs.py` must stay untouched.

**Residual:** no strict run at base `28cae179` (static projection only), and git was not invoked, so committed-ledger equality at REV remains for L1 to measure. Report path `.ufo/waves/round-23/w1/CurrentMonitor.md` not written — wave context forbids report writes. Confidence: high on selector/ledger/mechanism and section maps; medium on current coverage until L1's strict run.
